findings: Stage 2 returned formal_weaker: the direct/inverse-image, surjection, empty/terminal/product clauses are faithful, but the union clause supp(Union_i A^i) has no counterpart in the type encoding (iCoprod models the disjoint union), and the intersection/difference clauses are established only for componentwise subsets of a common carrier (fixed-ambient carrier model, representation D2). Representation-level gap, not a proof gap. Transcript blocks/audits/B-P001-correspondence.md.
independence_caveat: Audit protocol: two-stage-blind. All stages share the model family deepseek, so common blind spots are not excluded.
